statements.statement:
theorem copy_equal_original (b : Bytes) :
    PV_B2_C_249.host_sampler.gamma_sample b = originalGamma b

theorem selected_callback (ops : ExternalFuns) (b : Bytes) :
    (selected ops).op249 b = mapResult toNative (originalGamma b)

theorem gamma_law (ops : ExternalFuns) (b : Bytes) :
    ∃ a : PV_B2_C_GammaNumeric.Digits,
      (selected ops).op249 b = ok (toNative (PV_B2_C_ArrayDigits.raw a)) ∧ Canonical a ∧
      AspisR1.SamplerAddDigits.digitsValue AspisR1.SamplerMachineBounds.P (values a) =
        AspisR1.SourceSamplerByteRank.rank b % (AspisR1.SamplerMachineBounds.P^8-1)+1 ∧
      0 < AspisR1.SamplerAddDigits.digitsValue AspisR1.SamplerMachineBounds.P (values a) ∧
      AspisR1.SamplerAddDigits.digitsValue AspisR1.SamplerMachineBounds.P (values a) <
        AspisR1.SamplerMachineBounds.P^8

theorem nonfailure (ops : ExternalFuns) (b : Bytes) :
    ∃ out, (selected ops).op249 b = ok out

theorem nonvacuity (ops : ExternalFuns) :
    ∃ out, (selected ops).op249 (Array.repeat 32#usize 0#u8) = ok out
theorem dictionaries (ops : ExternalFuns) : selected ops = originalDictionary ops

theorem observations {O : Sort _} (observe : ExternalFuns → O) (ops : ExternalFuns) :
    observe (selected ops) = observe (originalDictionary ops)

theorem sampler_rows (ops : ExternalFuns) (b : Bytes) :
    (PV_B2_E_GammaOriginal.selected ops).op249 b =
      mapResult toNative (PV_B2_E_GammaOriginal.originalGamma b) ∧
    (PV_B2_E_GammaOriginal.selected ops).op250 b =
      mapResult toNative (original b)

theorem dictionary_observations {O : Sort _} (observe : ExternalFuns → O)
    (ops : ExternalFuns) :
    observe (PV_B2_E_GammaOriginal.selected ops) =
      observe (PV_B2_E_GammaOriginal.originalDictionary ops)

nonvacuity: For every supplied ExternalFuns dictionary the selected callback succeeds at the zero block; all-input success is also proved; no success/canonicality/native equality premise.
native_link_evidence_class: Reviewed structural frozen-source representation plus universal Lean complete Result equality to that representation and exact native-carrier installation. Finite optimized differential is supporting fidelity evidence, not universal native execution refinement.
scope: Selected source/callback instance only. Endpoint/deployment premises, native RunJoin V165/V167 and physical L1/L2/L3 remain.
